title: feat(app-shell): the built-in metadata designers leave the console's first load (objectui#11939 step 2)
body:
Fixes #11939

Clause-②: yes

Step 2 of objectui#6795's order, as ruled on objectui#11942 (item C, comment 6056819248): the built-in metadata designers leave the console's first load. Step 1 (`a835c31`, PR objectui#11963) made their three registries observable, so a reader that rendered before a designer was registered re-renders when it is; this step relies on that. Neither refused shape of ruling A on objectui#11798 is used: there is no per-route await and no lazy sub-entry — importing the package still registers every built-in designer with no host action.

Implemented by a dispatched `os-dev` (session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`), claim 6060604189 as amended by the seat after report 6062475046.

## Open ruling — the eager ceiling is deliberately UNCHANGED

`MAX_EAGER_CLOSURE_GZIP_BYTES`, `BASELINE` and their docblock are not edited in this PR. The ruling's reclaim formula (lower by the bytes that leave PLUS objectui#11949's 5,120 B allowance) lands 4,057 B under this branch's own reading, because `main`'s drift after the allowance landed spent 4,057 B of it in chunks that stay eager. That falsifies the formula's premise, so the number goes back to the maintainer's decision box on objectui#11939 (report 6062475046, open question 1, options A to D).

⇒ **`Bundle Analysis` is expected to exit 2 on this PR** — the gate's gauge verdict "1 ceiling has DRIFTED more than one 89.0 KB regression above the payload it governs" — until the ruling lands and the constant is re-pinned in this PR. That is the gate reporting the bytes that left, not a regression.

The arithmetic the ruling needs, on the builds below:

| | gzip bytes |
|:--|--:|
| ceiling today | 3,391,484 |
| allowance (objectui#11949) | 5,120 |
| pre-allowance line | 3,386,364 |
| `main` at the allowance commit `1c51e973` | 3,385,979 (385 under the line) |
| `main` at `d7e9e9ab` (control) | 3,390,421 (4,057 over the line) |
| this branch | 3,234,889 |
| bytes that left | 155,532 |
| ruling formula: 3,391,484 − 155,532 − 5,120 | 3,230,832 (4,057 under this branch's reading) |

Growth of `main` from `1c51e973` to `d7e9e9ab`, by eager chunk (gzip): `src` +2,366, `i18n` (holds `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`) +1,192, `SchemaForm` +902, `ui-components` +879, `default-inspector-registry` +193, `plugin-form` +151, `ReportDefaultInspector` +102, `studioScope` −1,706; total +4,442.

## When each built-in becomes available

| | before (`d7e9e9ab`) | after (this PR) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| built-in previews, scoped inspectors, default inspectors | registered while the package entry is evaluated (bare import of `register-builtins.ts`) | registered when the chunk the entry loads with a dynamic `import()` arrives: the entry's module scope runs `import('./views/metadata-admin/register-builtin-designers.js').then(({ registerBuiltinDesigners }) => registerBuiltinDesigners())`, with a `.catch` that logs one `console.error` |
| Related-tab anchors, fallback JSONSchemas, datasource resource | during the entry's evaluation | unchanged — their registries are not observable, so a late arrival would never reach a reader; they stay in `register-builtins.ts` |
| Studio canvas preview for `object` (`studio-canvas-preview.tsx`, the fourth registry) | during the entry's evaluation | unchanged — kept eager: 2,943 rendered bytes in the entry chunk, reached by the entry's named re-exports, not moved by this change, so it needs no observability |

Between a reader's first render and the chunk's arrival, every reader shows its existing "designer missing" state, then the designer, with no reload (step 1's hooks). A plain `get*` / `list*` read right after importing the package can find no built-in yet; that is stated in the changeset. No export is added, removed or changed.

## How a host's own registration keeps precedence

The built-ins register inside `registerAsBuiltIns` (module-internal, in `preview-registry.ts`): during that pass the shared store fills only a type that has no entry, in all three observable registries. So:

- host registers first (right after importing the package, before the chunk lands): its component is kept, the built-in for that type is skipped — the case objectui#11798 measured being overwritten under a naive lazy door;
- host registers after the built-ins landed: `register*` replaces the built-in and readers re-render, last-write-wins as always.

`previews/index.ts` and `inspectors/index.ts` are untouched; they still call the public `register*`, and only the pass changes what a registration may replace.

## The `sideEffects` diff

None. `register-builtin-designers.ts` performs no load-time registration: it exports one function, which the entry's `.then` calls, so every bundler keeps it by its USE. Measured alternative (the dispatch's suggested route — a side-effectful module named in the array, both spellings): `check:side-effects-array` exits 1 with "STALE ./dist/views/metadata-admin/register-builtin-designers.js — the array names it, but nothing in it registers at load time", because the gate walks the entry's static edges only. `register-builtins.ts` keeps its two entries (it still registers three things at load time).

## Measurements

Instrument: `apps/console/vite.config.ts` through Vite `build()` with one read-only chunk-module dump plugin, `CI=true`, under `os-verify-lock.sh`, same container; calibrated against the ordinary `pnpm exec vite build`, which wrote the same `eagerGzipBytes` to the byte on `a835c314` (3,389,131) and on this branch (3,234,889).

| | `d7e9e9ab` | this branch (`ca267fc1`) |
|:--|--:|--:|
| eager closure, gzip | 3,390,421 | 3,234,889 |
| eager chunks | 337 of 2459 | 290 of 2475 |
| eager raw | 11,491,592 | 10,884,445 |

165 modules leave the eager closure and none joins. Rendered bytes by group: `metadata-admin/previews` 554,836 (56 modules), `metadata-admin/inspectors` 396,388 (38), other `metadata-admin` 41,664 (12: the three registries, the external-datasource panels, three schema helpers, `metadata-form-i18n`), `lucide-react` icons 37,230 (56), `@objectstack/spec` `identity/index.mjs` 27,098 (1), `InterfaceListPage` + `pageKindNode` 14,572. Per-chunk gzip: `src` −150,475, `RecordDetailView` −19,483, `default-inspector-registry` −13,262 (left), 56 `vendor-icon-*` chunks −16,781, `vendor-objectstack` −6,565, `createDerive` −1,555, re-chunked residue +66,456 over 29 chunks; net −155,532.

Budgeted chunks: `vendor-objectstack` 1,605,816 → 1,599,251 (ceiling 1,623,000, headroom 0.26x, sensitivity green), `ui-components` 285,698 → 285,672, `framework` 75,227 → 75,208, `i18n-locale-en` 45,180 unchanged. No per-chunk ceiling, baseline or membership row is invalidated.

The `main` merged afterwards (`989b1908`) touched Studio sources only; the readings above are of `d7e9e9ab` and its merge.

## Tests

New pins:

- `views/metadata-admin/__tests__/builtinDesigners.hostPrecedence-11939.test.tsx` — host-first kept in all three registries; host-after replaces and its reader re-renders; a second pass changes no entry and commits no render (counted with `React.Profiler`).
- `views/metadata-admin/__tests__/builtinDesigners.lateArrival-11939.test.tsx` — the Data pillar field rail (objectui#6795's silent-failure site) shows its missing-inspector sentence, then the REAL `ObjectFieldInspector` when `registerBuiltinDesigners()` lands, with no remount.
- `src/__tests__/entryRegistersBuiltinDesigners-11939.test.tsx` — importing the package entry registers `FlowPreview`, `FlowInspector` and `HookDefaultInspector` by identity, with no host call.

Suites that relied on synchronous registration now register explicitly at module scope: five `metadata-admin` suites that bare-import `./register-builtins`, and three console suites (`preview-samples-designer-options`, `App.agentChatLink-10640`, `ApiConsolePage.requestPreset-10591`), which load the registration with `vi.importActual` so the app-shell sources stay out of the console's `tsc` program.

The dev-only designer gallery waits for the entry's own chunk through the public `useRegisteredMetadataPreviewTypes` hook before it mounts its list. Browser check (the `verify` skill, own dev server): "Loading the built-in designers…" at DOMContentLoaded, then 19 designer sections; control on `d7e9e9ab`: 19 sections.

Reverse verification, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on a committed tree, each restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty:

1. the built-in pass's skip removed → the host-precedence pin goes RED 2 of 3 ("expected [Function FlowPreview] to be [Function HostFlowPreview]");
2. the entry's `.then` no longer calling the registration → the entry pin goes RED (no designer registered);
3. the entry importing the designers statically again → console eager closure 3,392,679 B, over today's ceiling by 1,195 and over every candidate lowered ceiling by at least 156,727. The first attempt was a no-op the tool refused (its replacement contained its anchor); re-run with a non-overlapping anchor.

On the final head `9ff0b2f8` (after merging `989b1908`): 26 targeted files, 387 tests passed — the new pins, step 1's late-registration and registry-missing/partial/populated suites, every edited suite, the Studio suites `main` brought in, and the side-effects, lazy-views and eager-closure-budget script tests; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check` exit 0; `check:side-effects-array`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations` and the changeset-presence check exit 0, and `check:sdui-registration-pins` exits 0 on this branch's console build. Before that merge, on `7a30a7b6`: 186 derived files (every suite that imports the entry, `register-builtins`, the registries or a built-in registrar), 185 passed — the one failure is the flake noted under Acceptance notes.

## Deviations

- The dispatch's suggested side-effectful door module named in `sideEffects` was not taken (measured STALE, above); the door is a pure module plus an explicit call.
- Host precedence lives in one built-in pass in the shared store rather than per-registry helpers, so the built-in registrars stay untouched.
- The gallery's first form imported the registration by workspace source path; reverted, because it pulled five designer files into the console's `noUnusedLocals` type-check (TS6133 ×5).
- `origin/main` merged twice (`d7e9e9ab`, `989b1908`), never rebased.
- The ceiling is untouched (Open ruling, above).

## Acceptance notes

Observed, not filed (no carrier):

- The ineffective-dynamic-import ledger did not flag ablation 3 (a static import beside the dynamic one): it printed its usual 43 pinned entries. The eager-closure gate is what catches that edge.
- On a cold deep link, a Studio pillar can show its "designer missing" sentence for the moment the designers' chunk is in flight, then recover. The sentences state only what is true when they render, as their i18n comment requires.
- `inspectors/index.ts`'s header still says it is imported as a side effect from `metadata-admin/index.ts` (stale since objectui#6776). `previews/index.ts`'s "register after this module runs, last-write-wins" is still true, and now incomplete (a host may also register before; it is kept).
- `scripts/vite-declared-lazy-views.ts` keeps its "25 runtime values" count: it sits in the dated objectui#6776 narrative.
- `ObjectHooksPanel.newHookTarget-11820.test.tsx` failed once in a 186-file parallel batch (its label not yet hydrated) and passes alone on this branch and on `d7e9e9ab`.
